message:
[Backport 5.x] feat: add routerOptions.compile to use find-my-way compiler mode (#7116)

Proposal:

Manual backport of #7096 to `5.x`: the automated backport failed with
conflicts, see
https://github.com/fastify/fastify/pull/7096#issuecomment-6155131364.

Cherry-pick of fcba984c0a41d7cfacff5234e0594d3b561cb804 with these
conflict resolutions:

- `build/build-validation.js` / `lib/config-validator.js`: `main` moved
`allowUnsafeRegex`, `caseSensitive` and `constraints` into
`routerOptions`, which is not the case on 5.x. Only `compile: false` is
added, then the validator was regenerated with `npm run
build:validation`.
- `fastify.d.ts`: only `compile?: boolean` is added to
`FastifyRouterOptions`, without the `constraints` rework from v6.
- `fastify.js`: kept `VERSION = '5.12.7'`.
- `test/internals/initial-config.test.js`: kept the 5.x snapshot (no
`routerOptions` in the defaults).
- `lib/route.js`: added the `defaultInitOptions` import from
`./initial-config-validation.js`, which `main` already had and the new
`routerOptions.compile ??=` line needs.
- `test/router-compile.test.js`: on 5.x `initialConfig.routerOptions` is
only exposed when the user passes it, so the "defaults to false" test
asserts `undefined` instead of `.compile === false`. Everything else is
unchanged.

Note:

`.npmrc` also carries over the `min-release-age-exclude[]=find-my-way`
entry, needed until `find-my-way@9.10.0` is older than 7 days
(2026-10-17).

---------

Signed-off-by: Tony133 <a.tripodi133@gmail.com>
Co-authored-by: Matteo Collina <hello@matteocollina.com>
